editorial:
You follow Dave Skylark and Aaron Rapaport as they turn a really celebrity interview into a wild spy mission. The movie mixes silly jokes with big action, so you get laughs and explosions in the same scene. James Franco and Seth Rogen keep the energy loose, and the North Korea setting gives everything a strange, risky edge. It is not subtle, but it knows that and leans into the chaos with confidence.

The best parts are the buddy chemistry and the over-the-top set pieces, especially when the plan falls apart. Some jokes run long, and the humor can be very crude, so it is not for everyone. If you want a really loud, dumb-fun comedy with action, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray. Skip it if you prefer smart, quiet humor with friends on a weekend night.
endingExplained: In the final interview, Dave stops playing nice and calls out Kim as a fraud. Kim gets angry, pulls a gun, and shoots Dave, but Sook shoots Kim first. Dave, Aaron, and Sook escape in a tank, cross into safety, and return home. Their show finally becomes a hit, and the mission ends with Kim dead and the friends alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud buddy comedies and silly action.
